onscreen_lines.desc: Firm fixed price for remediation and demolition of 919 N St. SW Cedar Rapids, IA, per the bid documents.
onscreen_lines.block: 1 Firm fixed price for remediation and demolition of 919 N St. SW Cedar Rapids, IA, per the bid documents. 1 EA No Response

onscreen_lines.desc: Firm fixed price for discovery item - Septic Tank
onscreen_lines.note: If discovery of a septic tank takes place during demolition, Contractor is required to have it pumped by a certified licensed pumping service, all materials removed and disposed of at Site #2, then backfilled per Iowa DR requirements and as stated in the RFB. This item must have written permission from the Project Manager in advance of any work.
onscreen_lines.block: 2 Firm fixed price for discovery item - Septic Tank 1 EA No Response

onscreen_lines.desc: Firm fixed price of discovery item - Cistern
onscreen_lines.note: If discovery of a cistern takes place during demolition, Contractor shall notify the City’s Project Manager or designee immediately. Once the all clear has been given any liquid shall be pumped and the debris shall be moved and disposed of at Site #2 as regular C&D. This item must have written permission from the Project Manager in advance of any work.
onscreen_lines.block: 3 Firm fixed price of discovery item - Cistern 1 EA No Response
